name: Rootling · Gremlet #40
description:
A root that wriggled up out of the garden to see the sun. Walks on its tendrils.

One of 50 one-of-a-kind Gremlets. Owning this token unlocks Rootling in the Gremlets desktop app, where it walks on your windows, naps, plays with other Gremlets and shows off its signature move.
